Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

Gumroad and Stripe offer a simple, user-friendly experience for creators to sell digital products, such as PDF guides. However, their restriction to 46 countries forces creators in restricted areas to seek alternative solutions. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to deploy their own digital stores, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, regardless of geographical location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Stripe restrict access to creators in countries not supported by their payment processors, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. This leaves these creators without a viable solution to sell digital products, forcing them to seek alternative payment processors or abandon their business. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like Edge Commerce Stack, allows creators to deploy their own digital stores, bypassing the restrictions imposed by payment processors like Stripe.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad and Stripe charge 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction, making it difficult for creators to scale their business, especially in countries with high transaction fees. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments, which charges a flat 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly reducing the real costs for creators. Additionally, Edge Commerce Stack offers instant payment processing, eliminating the need for wait times.
Edge Commerce Stack provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to deploy their own digital stores, regardless of geographical location.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Stripe require creators to rely on their platforms for payment processing and product delivery, limiting their ownership and control over their digital stores. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like Edge Commerce Stack, allows creators to own and control every aspect of their digital stores, including payment processing, product delivery, and data storage. This level of automation and control enables creators to scale their business more efficiently and effectively.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing between Gumroad and Stripe, and sovereign commerce infrastructure like Edge Commerce Stack, consider the following factors: your target audience, payment processor fees, and the level of ownership and control you require over your digital store. If you're a creator in a restricted country, Edge Commerce Stack may be the better choice, as it provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to deploy your own digital store, regardless of geographical location.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
With Edge Commerce Stack, you can reduce real costs and increase payment velocity, making it easier to scale your business.

You can browse our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, including the Edge Commerce Stack, which offers a comprehensive solution for creators in restricted countries.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
